body.x: KAMON(www.kamon.tv) introduced '360-degree Photography VR Filming System' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The TV program 'Hot Place 360' launching at KBS, the public TV in Korea, announced that KAMON's '360-degree Photography VR Filming System' will be using for the program so it is expected to give interactive experiences to the audience. '360-degree Photography VR Filming System' features variety mixed content that can realize hybrid video.

HMD(Head Mounted Display) will allow users to experience virtual reality in best condition. Therefore, HMD is highly practical in theme park virtual reality experience. 360-degree video is available on Smart devices such as iOS, Android, Window PC, Smart TV, Set-top Box and on website.

CEO Youn-Jung Kim said, "Now we see that a lot of content inverstors are substantially interested in us. We plan to discover foreign partners and market places in the base of film company, broadcaster, theme park related company."

KAMON participated in the show as it had been selected for excellent startups by SmartContentCenter. KAMON equally placed its service to let foreign reporters learn the service at Showstoppers which was important media press event. Furthermore, KAMON had chance to get advice about global marketing from Strong Ventures CEO John Nam, Tapas media CEO Chang-Won Kim, KOTRA SV Sung-Kyu Lee at 3:1 'CES Global Consulting Program'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
